messages:
sam: Quick kickoff 10am sync was useful. Planning a small experiment on the pricing page next sprint: show a bundled offer + a quick feature calculator modal. Goal: fewer support/FAQ opens and higher demo intent. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya: Metrics to watch? demo CTA CTR, demo conversions, FAQ collapse rate, and lead quality (SAO/SQL ratio).
devon: Im on events. Propose: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_demo_cta_click. Add props: calc_total (0-100), bundle_variant.
nana: bundle name call 1 Growth Pack vs Scale Bundle. Which maps to our GTM messaging?
nana: (sorry typo) ana: I like Growth Pack1 feels less enterprise-y on calls.
olivia: Growth Pack reads better in copy. Keep it clear: "Growth Pack" 
sam: AB plan: control = current pricing; v1 = Growth Pack + calc gating (demo CTA shown when calc_total >= 70); v2 = Scale Bundle + inline demo CTA without gating. 10% traffic to start.
maya: Owners: dev for instrumentation, marketing for copy, sdrs for routing rules. Reporting windows 7d & 14d.
devon: GTM snippet example to push into dataLayer on submit:
```
window.dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_calc_submit',
  calc_total: 78,
  bundle_variant: 'growth_pack_v1'
});
```

devon: Also suggest adding property "selected_features" as a comma list for initial analysis, but we can drop it later for privacy.
analytics-bot: Recommendation: ensure sample size >= 500 per variant before drawing conclusions; use pooled t-test for demo CTR.
sam: Routing rule for sales: if calc_total >= 75 OR user selects "enterprise" in the calc -> tag lead with "pb_high_intent" and route to AE queue; else tag "pb_lead" and route to SDR queue. Ops: can you add both tags on form submit?
devon: Yep. Example API call: POST /api/leads {"tags":["pb_high_intent"],"score":calc_total,"variant":"growth_pack_v1"} ; I'll implement after GTM event.
olivia: FAQ microcopy needed. Short Q: "How are overages billed?" Short A (one line): "Monthly at your plan's metered rate; reach billing to set a cap." Keep < 2 lines.
maya: Also remove duplicate Qs around committed vs metered to reduce clicks.
analytics-bot: Flag reminder: feature-flag "pricing-bundle-experiment" slated for 2026-05-05 14:00 UTC. Watch rollout logs and experiment health.
sam: Timeline: finalize copy Wed EOD, instrumentation done Thurs, soft launch Fri to 10%, ramp Monday to 50% if healthy. Escalation channel = #release-war-room.
devon: I'll create the dashboard: variant conversion, calc_total histogram, FAQ click rate, lead tags by variant. Share link when ready.
olivia: I'll triage demo requests for the first 48h and follow-up on high-intent leads. Tag me @olivia on those.
sam: Great work. Ping here with the GTM push ID and dashboard link. :thumbsup:
